mainEntity.name: How do I choose a reliable contractor for sticking window repair in Daly City or South San Francisco?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for sticking window repair in areas like Daly City or South San Francisco, look for companies with a strong local presence and positive reviews. Verify that they are licensed and insured as a general contractor. Request detailed estimates that outline the scope of work and materials. Ask about their experience with various window types and materials. A reputable contractor should offer a clear explanation of the problem and proposed solutions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a local, licensed, and insured contractor with good reviews. Request detailed estimates and inquire about their experience with different window types to ensure reliability.
